tools.name: purge_expired_course_drafts
tools.description: Looks up draft courses that have not been edited for a given number of days and permanently deletes them along with their draft lessons. Returns the titles of the deleted drafts.

params.name: days_idle
params.description: Number of days without edits before a draft is deleted

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the LMS sqlite database

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta


def purge_expired_course_drafts(days_idle: int, db_path: str = "lms.db") -> dict:
    cut = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=days_idle)).isoformat()
    con = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, title FROM courses WHERE status = 'draft' AND updated_at < ?",
        (cut,),
    )
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    if not rows:
        con.close()
        return {"deleted": [], "count": 0}
    ids = [r[0] for r in rows]
    marks = ",".join("?" for _ in ids)
    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM lessons WHERE course_id IN ({marks})", ids)
    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM courses WHERE id IN ({marks})", ids)
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return {"deleted": [r[1] for r in rows], "count": len(rows)}

tools.name: transfer_course_to_new_instructor
tools.description: Makes another instructor the owner of a course, moves the course into that instructor's catalog folder, and starts a job that rebuilds the course's access permissions.

params.name: course_id
params.description: ID of the course to transfer

params.name: new_instructor_id
params.description: ID of the instructor who will own the course

tools.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass
import requests
from agents import function_tool

LMS_API = "https://lms.internal.example.com/api"


@dataclass
class TransferResult:
    course_id: str
    new_owner: str
    folder: str
    job_id: str


@function_tool
def transfer_course_to_new_instructor(course_id: str, new_instructor_id: str) -> TransferResult:
    r = requests.post(
        f"{LMS_API}/courses/{course_id}/transfer",
        json={"owner_id": new_instructor_id, "move_to_catalog": True},
        timeout=30,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    d = r.json()
    j = requests.post(f"{LMS_API}/jobs/rebuild-permissions", json={"course_id": course_id}, timeout=30)
    j.raise_for_status()
    return TransferResult(course_id, new_instructor_id, d["folder"], j.json()["job_id"])

tools.name: remove_instructor_and_delete_their_courses
tools.description: Removes an instructor's teaching role and revokes their access tokens, then permanently deletes all of their unpublished courses and lessons. Published courses are kept and reassigned to a replacement instructor.

params.name: instructor_id
params.description: ID of the instructor to remove

params.name: replacement_instructor_id
params.description: ID of the instructor who takes over published courses

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("lms")
DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "lms.db"


@mcp.tool()
def remove_instructor_and_delete_their_courses(instructor_id: str, replacement_instructor_id: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()

    replacement_exists = database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = ? AND role = 'instructor'",
        (replacement_instructor_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if replacement_exists is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "replacement instructor not found"}

    unpublished_course_rows = database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM courses WHERE owner_id = ? AND status != 'published'",
        (instructor_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    unpublished_course_ids = [row[0] for row in unpublished_course_rows]

    number_of_lessons_deleted = 0
    for each_course_id in unpublished_course_ids:
        lesson_delete_result = database_cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM lessons WHERE course_id = ?", (each_course_id,)
        )
        number_of_lessons_deleted += lesson_delete_result.rowcount
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM courses WHERE id = ?", (each_course_id,))

    reassigned_result = database_cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE courses SET owner_id = ? WHERE owner_id = ? AND status = 'published'",
        (replacement_instructor_id, instructor_id),
    )
    database_cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE users SET role = 'student' WHERE id = ?", (instructor_id,)
    )
    token_delete_result = database_cursor.execute(
        "DELETE FROM access_tokens WHERE user_id = ?", (instructor_id,)
    )

    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "courses_deleted": len(unpublished_course_ids),
        "lessons_deleted": number_of_lessons_deleted,
        "courses_reassigned": reassigned_result.rowcount,
        "tokens_revoked": token_delete_result.rowcount,
    }
